notes.title: New demo patch 0.3.0
notes.content:
Patch 0.3.0:

New 3D nippers when cutting the runners.

Pieces go directly to the mat to build the model, no more 2d buttons.

The manual advances automatically when you complete the page.

Now you can drag the manual window.

New tutorials.

Now you can start painting from the second model.

Previously completed models have been reset.

notes.title: New demo patch 0.2.4
notes.content:
Patch 0.2.4:

Color buttons were replaced with a color wheel so you can choose the colors you like.

New 4th style button for more realistic color builds.

notes.title: New demo patch 0.2.3
notes.content:
Patch 0.2.3:

New buttons to control the height position of you model

New favorite save slot button to display the one you want

notes.title: New demo patch 0.2.2
notes.content:
Patch 0.2.2:

You can now drag and cut with just the left click.

3D models and painting optimized to consume much less resources.

Had to reset saves slots, sorry.

notes.title: New demo patch 0.2.1
notes.content:
Patch 0.2.1:

For some people the style change buttons were not working, with this patch I hope it will be fixed for everyone.

notes.title: New demo patch 0.2.0
notes.content:
Patch 0.2.0:

3 graphic style options when customizing your build.

minor fixes

notes.title: New demo patch
notes.content:
Patch 0.1.3:

Glow slider

Color picker button

Rotation type toggle button

Previously saved poses and colors have been reset to test steam cloud save

minor fixes

notes.title: Demo patch 0.0.2
notes.content:
Adjust the snap distance between pieces.
 Auto rotate models in the main menu.
 Darken the background wall so it's not so white.
 Make the mouse scroll wheel only work on the game screen.
 Flash the parts that can be painted with the bucket.
 Some pieces will become transparent depending on the page you're on.
 Improved piece outlines.
 Adjust the interface to fit more resolutions


Thanks all for your feedback.
